task: Get a reminder to call the camp director about Rafi's waitlist, and see whether the app can help you follow up with the camp.
transcript: open: home screen asked 'What can I help with?' with example prompts and a promise that nothing is sent without my OK.
type + enter: 'Remind me to call the camp director about Rafi's waitlist, and can you help me follow up with the camp?'; the button read 'Sending'.
look after ~20s: a page titled 'Camp waitlist follow-up for Rafi' said 'A new helper, family-admin, is on it' with 'Change' and 'Show work' links, and 'Working on it...'.

wait 30 + look: the answer arrived; the bottom showed questions to ask on the call (final decisions, room in another session) and a draft email to Marcy, 'Re: Rafi Levin - Session 2 waitlist', marked 'I haven't sent it', with 'Reply "send it"' to send.
looked at the screenshot: the answer was long and I only saw its bottom; I could not see whether the reminder was set.
type + enter: 'Did you set the reminder to call her? When?'; screen showed 'Working on it...'.
waited about 4.5 minutes (9 x wait 30): screen never changed, still 'Working on it' and the times stayed at 'just now' / '1 min ago'.

tap 'Chat': the tap reported an error, but the screen then showed the reply, timestamped 5 min ago: reminder set for tomorrow, Friday Nov 13 at 11:00 am, calling Marcy Feld at Camp Kaylie (845) 555-0142, and it will check for an email from her before the reminder.
tap 'Workspace' and tap 'Ideas': both returned an error and the screen did not change; I stopped there.
stumbles: The first answer was long and on a phone I landed at the bottom (the email draft); I could not tell whether the reminder was actually set without asking again.

My follow-up question showed 'Working on it' for ~4.5 minutes while the reply had actually arrived about 5 minutes earlier; the screen did not update until I tapped something. With ChatGPT I would have assumed it was stuck.
'A new helper, family-admin, is on it' reads like computer talk; I don't know what a helper or family-admin is.
Tapping the bottom tabs (Chat, Workspace, Ideas) did nothing visible; Workspace and Ideas never opened.
I could not check the answer against my own email or calendar from the app, so I am taking the director's name, phone number and Friday 11am on trust (the date is right: tomorrow is Friday Nov 13).
verdict: The app did what I asked: it set a call reminder for tomorrow at 11 with Marcy's name and number, gave me questions to ask, and wrote a follow-up email it clearly had not sent. But the reply to my follow-up sat hidden behind 'Working on it' for minutes and the tabs did not respond, so I would have thought it was broken without poking at it.
